variants.name: 开放式帐篷商店
variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE SMALL 512x512 concept-preview image of a general merchant shop building for the provided forest camp game. Reference image 1 is ONLY the existing camp style and camera reference. Match the surrounding camp buildings very closely: soft hand-painted 2D storybook fantasy, cream canvas, natural weathered timber, subdued green-blue fabric, light green moss, modest gold lantern light, broad clear painted shapes with genuine material detail, the elevated three-quarter view of the left equipment tent in the reference. Emphasize an OPEN FRONT with a broad unobstructed view deep into the interior: visible floor, back shelves, side racks and countertop, as an inviting room the player could enter. The roof should occupy at most the top quarter of the silhouette, with the open interior occupying most of the front. This is a GENERAL STORE with balanced merchandise: neatly hung leather armor, a shield and a sheathed blade, sacks of provisions, baskets and rolled cloth, a few bottles, a small stack of books or scrolls. Give equal attention to equipment, supplies and household/adventuring goods. Clear readable thumbnail composition, not a polished final asset. Isolated complete building and attached display props, transparent background, spacious margins. No people, lettering, UI, floating labels, watermark, dramatic black shadow or complex scenery. Do not make a specialized magical library or dominant closed cottage roof. Design A: A broad open-front canvas merchant tent with low cream fabric canopy on sturdy rough wooden poles, tied-back side curtains, interior shelves visible from floor to ceiling, central wooden counter, simple teal-and-gold cloth banner. Closely echo the left equipment tent in the camp reference while creating a distinct general shop.
